raw_tail:
The code I was asked to review isn't in the repository. `src/vretrieval/` does not exist, and `from vretrieval import Retriever, Hit, VisibleSet` fails with `ModuleNotFoundError`. That means none of R1–R12 can be met or tested, including the protected rules R2, R2a, R3, R4, R6 and R7.

The only code under `src/` is `src/cards/`. It belongs to a different work package, WP-E15C (entity cards and context assembly, a `Brain` class). It imports `factstore.text`, not `e15store`, so it doesn't even import here (`ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'factstore'`). I didn't review `src/cards/` against WP-E15, because it was never meant to meet that spec. Either the wrong source tree was supplied or the package was never written. Once the real `src/vretrieval/` is provided, a proper review can be done.
